title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Michael Kim’s Historic 59
items.text: Michael Kim shot a bogey-free 12-under 59 in Round 2 of the 3M Open, becoming the 15th player to break 60 on the PGA Tour and opening a three-shot lead at 14 under.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau Open Penalty
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau said a two-stroke penalty at the Open Championship, for trampling down grass behind his ball, cost him the Claret Jug as he finished tied 14th but rebounded with an eight-under 64 in LIV Golf UK.
